_note: The rail's key-figure cards. The content-first source format has no rail, but every article carries 3-4 cards, so these were drafted on 2026-09-11 for Leon's review. Each number and each sentence is taken verbatim from the article; only the short 'k' labels are new. build_article.py verify refuses a rail number the article does not contain.

cards.p: A keyword that is performing exactly as expected will show you zero sales after eight clicks roughly four times out of ten.
If you do not know your conversion rate yet, use 22 clicks.

cards.k: Days for one keyword to get there
cards.p: Spread across 10 keywords that is 2 clicks per keyword per day, so a single keyword takes 11 days to reach 22 clicks.
